evidence.note: Beam notes 3: 8000 psi at 28 days, 7000 psi at prestressing.
Design stresses and general note 2. Superstructure/end bents Class C; interior bents Class A.
ASTM A416 low-relaxation 0.6 in strand. Jacking force is not effective force after losses; prestress is not applied in this incremental pilot.
End-section rows total 26 (17+4+3+2) and 30 (17+8+3+2). Recorded only; strand stiffness and force excluded.
150 pcf and K1=1 normal-weight reference defaults. Not measured density or aggregate factor. Used for E derivation and gravity unit weight.
0.2; not needed by the Euler-Bernoulli beam formulation.
Recorded for later reinforced/prestressed analysis. Steel stiffness is not included now.
8 in slab includes 0.5 in sacrificial surface; only 7.5 in credited for stiffness. Spans 80/90/80 ft.
Four symmetric girder lines at 8 ft 9 in spacing.
Bearing centers 1 ft either side of interior bent centers; beam lengths 80 ft 3 in / 89 ft 6 in / 80 ft 3 in.

Dimensioned typical midspan polygon: 36 in depth, 49 in top flange, 40 in bottom flange, 8 in web; 3/4 in bottom chamfers included. Used throughout; local end-section changes, holes and embedded steel are excluded. Section properties are integrated, not manufacturer-certified.
Uniform 2 in provisional haunch for composite section. Actual haunch varies with beam camber and profile; no uniform 2 in value is claimed in the drawings.
Future wearing 35 psf is a separate post-composite increment applied over 30 ft roadway by assumption. 15 psf forms are recorded but excluded from current cases.
Research test pressure, uniform over full deck width; not HL-93 or a load rating case.

assumptions: Only incremental, longitudinal, nominal elastic girder stresses are computed; no total stress or local stress concentrations.
Four independent beam lines; transverse deck load distribution uses tributary width. No torsion, transverse grillage or local plate action.
After-composite cases use continuous gross uncracked transformed sections over bent centerlines, with ideal vertical restraints. Integral-abutment and semi-fixed-pier flexibility are not modeled.
Free versus fixed end rotation is a sensitivity comparison, not actual support identification or guaranteed bounds.
Structural deck thickness 7.5 in, full composite action, effective width equal to tributary width, constant assumed 2 in haunch of width 49 in.
Camber, grade and crossfall are omitted from the analysis axes. Original geometry is retained for display only.
Prestress and losses, reinforcing/strand stiffness, cracking, creep, shrinkage, deck-pour sequence, diaphragm/barrier/form loads, thermal/seismic loads and moving vehicles are excluded.
The bare-girder case uses 28-day E and the individual bearing locations. Its downward gravity displacement is not net camber or transfer-stage response.
Unanalyzed parts remain gray. Color does not indicate structural safety; no load factors or capacity checks are applied.
